propositions: The divergent_implementation axis fires on only 7.72% of plan-v3 findings and has never been calibrated; 90% of omitted-scope findings score it as none despite being the intended detection target.

The axis must transition from ordinal (none/low/medium/high) to a closed Literal set (none, contradicts_reality, omits_required_site, incomplete_enumeration) with divergence-kind-specific hard floors at 0.85 for the first two and a below-threshold contribution for the third.

impact_plan must be refactored to exclude divergent_implementation and ac_unverifiable from the generic _SEV01 loop and drive both through kind-specific contribution maps (_DIVERGENCE_GRADE01 and _ORACLE_GRADE01) to prevent silent regression.

High-cost LLM-based calibration assessments (purpose-built eval suites, bulk re-review runs) must be rejected; calibration must use only zero-marginal-cost corpus replay and dogfooding against the existing REVIEW_RESULT sidecar.

A production-impact floor (Fix 2) is rejected because it escapes the novelty_priority_floor convergence constraint and creates non-terminating remediation loops where findings recur at high priority across rounds regardless of author action.

The plan-v3 cohort (18,085 findings) closes with the version bump to plan-v4; all existing fixtures using ordinal grades on the axis must migrate to the Literal set or parse, and both verifier prompts must define all three new grades with worked examples.
